claims.claim: Shaders that declare subroutine types or subroutine functions using the subroutine keyword are rejected by MGL's GLSL frontend (no subroutine keyword / type support).
claims.code_excerpt: Lexer/parser have no subroutine keyword path; compile fails for subroutine shaders (SILENT_GAP_AUDIT F15).
claims.spec_quote: Subroutine types are declared using a statement similar to a function declaration, with the subroutine keyword, as follows: subroutine returnType subroutineTypeName(...); Functions are associated with subroutine types ... by defining the function with the subroutine keyword and a list of subroutine types the function matches. Subroutine functionality is not available when generating SPIR-V.

claims.claim: MGL initializes GL_MAX_SUBROUTINES and GL_MAX_SUBROUTINE_UNIFORM_LOCATIONS to 0 while glGetString(GL_VERSION) advertises 4.6.0, so the core subroutine feature cannot be used within documented API limits.
claims.spec_quote: Subroutine functions can be assigned an explicit index in the shader between zero and the value of MAX_SUBROUTINES minus one.
claims.evidence: that the function could never be assigned to an active subroutine uniform. The subroutine functions can be assigned an explicit index in the shader between zero and the value of MAX_SUBROUTINES minus one. At link time, all active subroutines without an explicit index will be assigned an index between zero and the value of ACTIVE_SUBROUTINES minus one. An assigned index will never take the same index of an explicitly specified index in the shader, even if that subroutine is inactive.
